name: B10-0574/2025 (S&D) – Grave political situation in Guinea-Bissau after the coup of 26 November
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the grave political situation in Guinea-Bissau after the coup of 26 November
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns the military takeover in Guinea-Bissau on 26 November 2025, which stopped the election results from being announced. It asks for constitutional order to be restored and for the election results to be published without interference. It demands the release of arrested opposition leaders and others held without charge. It also calls for an independent investigation into violence against protesters and journalists, and for the European Council to consider sanctions on those responsible. This is a statement of position, not a change in law.

- The Parliament demands the release of detained opposition leaders and an end to repression; this affects them and civil society.
- It calls for verified election results to be published; this affects voters and the electoral commission.
- It asks the Council to consider sanctions on those behind the coup; no decision has been made yet.
